top_deficiency_types.title: Ensure that a nursing home area is free from accident hazards and provides adequate supervision to prevent accidents.
top_deficiency_types.category: Quality of Life and Care Deficiencies

top_deficiency_types.title: Install emergency lighting that can last at least 1 1/2 hours.
Ensure that special areas are constructed so that walls can resist fire for one hour or have an approved fire extinguishing system.
Have approved installation, maintenance and testing program for fire alarm systems.
Follow proper procedures when the automatic sprinkler systems was out of service for more than 10 hours.
Ensure heating and ventilation systems that have been properly installed according to the manufacturer's instructions.
Coordinate assessments with the pre-admission screening and resident review program; and referring for services as needed.
top_deficiency_types.category: Resident Assessment and Care Planning Deficiencies

top_deficiency_types.title: Develop and implement a complete care plan that meets all the resident's needs, with timetables and actions that can be measured.
top_deficiency_types.category: Resident Assessment and Care Planning Deficiencies

top_deficiency_types.title: Provide appropriate care for residents who are continent or incontinent of bowel/bladder, appropriate catheter care,  and appropriate care  to prevent urinary tract infections.
top_deficiency_types.category: Quality of Life and Care Deficiencies

top_deficiency_types.title: Ensure medication error rates are not 5 percent or greater.
